title: Jesus: Historical Figure and Mythic Archetype
description: History, language, and myth—five scholarly depths on a world-changing figure.

questions.question: What execution method do virtually all historians agree was used on Jesus?
questions.explanation: Crucifixion under Roman authority is among the most secure historical facts.

questions.question: The name Yeshua (Jesus) literally means what in Aramaic?
questions.explanation: Yeshua shares roots with Joshua (Yehoshua)—'YHWH saves.'

questions.question: Many scholars link the Star of Bethlehem to a conjunction of which two planets?
questions.explanation: A triple conjunction in Pisces around 7–6 BCE fits Mesopotamian royal portents.

questions.question: The Magi who sought the child were likely what profession in Babylon?
questions.explanation: Magi were scholar-priests who read celestial signs for kings.

questions.question: The Gospel genre in Greek is called 'euangelion'—meaning what?
questions.explanation: Euangelion was used for imperial victory proclamations before Christian usage.
